items.q: How is LOONO different from other dating apps?
items.a: We treat a long-term relationship as the premise, not an option. Members clear an ID and live-video check, the directory opens tier by tier, and your conditions can be stated very precisely — all of it pointing at one thing: serious people meeting serious people, faster.

items.q: Do I have to pay to use it?
items.a: Registering, completing your profile and setting basic conditions are free. Seeing full profiles and starting chats requires the matching membership tier. New members get a 30-day free trial and can cancel at any time.

items.q: What if we don't share a language?
items.a: The chat window translates live between Chinese, English and Russian, so you can preview exactly what the other person will read and avoid tone getting lost in translation.

items.q: Where do the verification badges come from?
items.a: Members submit supporting documents one by one; a badge turns colour only after a human review passes. Some badges carry an expiry date and move to pending when it lapses. Anything not submitted or not approved stays grey.

Sensitive conditions — an asset threshold, a specific personal requirement — are used for filtering only and are never shown to the other person, and they switch on or off automatically according to local law. You can start account deletion from Settings at any time; a 7-day cooling-off period applies.
